#!/bin/bash
# =============================================================
# Docker Weekly Cleanup Script
# Removes unused containers, images, volumes, and networks
# =============================================================

LOG_DIR="/var/log/docker-cleanup"
LOG_FILE="$LOG_DIR/cleanup-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).log"
RETAIN_LOGS=10  # Keep only the last N log files

mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"

log() {
    echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] $1" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
}

# ── Header ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log "============================================="
log " Docker Cleanup Started"
log "============================================="

# ── Pre-cleanup disk usage ────────────────────────────────────
log "[PRE-CLEANUP] Docker disk usage:"
docker system df 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"

# ── 1. Stop and remove exited / dead containers ───────────────
log "--- Removing stopped containers ---"
STOPPED=$(docker ps -aq --filter status=exited --filter status=dead 2>/dev/null)
if [ -n "$STOPPED" ]; then
    echo "$STOPPED" | xargs docker rm -v 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
else
    log "No stopped containers found."
fi
